title: Arithmetic conjectures for the normalized denominators of the Fabius function
source: Juan Arias de Reyna, “Arithmetic of the Fabius function”, arXiv:1702.06487 (2017). https://arxiv.org/abs/1702.06487
statement:
Let $D_n$ be the denominator sequence associated with the rational values of the Fabius function, and define

$$
A_n=2^{-\binom{n}{2}}D_n.
$$

For $n\geq 1$, set $K_n=A_{2n-1}$; thus $K_1=A_1$, and for $n\geq 2$,

$$
K_n=2^{-\binom{2n-1}{2}}D_{2n-1}=2^{-\binom{2n-2}{2}}D_{2n-2}.
$$

Finally, define

$$
H_n=\frac{K_n}{2(2n-1)!}.
$$

**Conjectured arithmetic properties.** The following statements appear to be true: $A_{2n}=A_{2n+1}$ for $n\geq 1$; $2(2n-1)!$ divides $K_n$; and $H_n$ is an odd integer.

These claims describe a proposed parity and divisibility pattern for the normalized denominator sequence arising in the arithmetic of the Fabius function. The supplied text presents them as observations believed to hold, but gives no proof or resolution.
summary: All three clauses of Conjecture 16 of Arias de Reyna on the common denominators of the values of the Fabius function at dyadic rationals hold: the stated coincidence of consecutive terms, the divisibility by 2(2n - 1)!, and the oddness and integrality of the normalized sequence H_n; moreover D_n is the least integer clearing all values of the function at the dyadic points of level n. Lean proves that a function satisfying the Fabius functional equation exists and is unique, derives its dyadic values from the moment recurrence, and proves the three clauses. The new mathematics is a triangular convolution with the Thue-Morse sequence, a propagation step through integer-valued polynomials, and a p-adic lemma on the first weighted minimum of a sequence of valuations.
